trigger: HER2-EXP-002: PMID 40464376 — SLC7A11 epigenetically upregulated as trastuzumab resistance mechanism in HER2+ BC
claim: Trastuzumab resistance in HER2+ BC epigenetically upregulates SLC7A11 (via H3K4me3 gain + DNA hypomethylation) as a primary escape mechanism (PMID 40464376, eLife 2025). This creates a ferroptosis dependency that T-DXd's DXd payload specifically exploits. T-DXd thus overcomes trastuzumab resistance by weaponizing the tumor's own escape mechanism. The complete mechanistic model: (1) MITOCHONDRIAL ARM — DXd → TOP1mt → VDAC3-HSPB1 → ferroptosis (published, PMID 39243601); (2) TRANSCRIPTIONAL ARM — trastuzumab-resistance-acquired SLC7A11-high state creates ferroptosis dependency exploitable by DXd; FBXL2-CD44high-xCT axis provides stemness-ferroptosis integration (Nat Cancer 2026 + Oncotarget 2016). Biomarker prediction: SLC7A11 IHC H-score in trastuzumab-pretreated HER2+ tumor banks is the immediately testable predictive biomarker for T-DXd ferroptosis efficacy.
mechanistic_update: v4 sharpens the SLC7A11 arm from 'passive biomarker' to 'actively acquired resistance mechanism exploitable by T-DXd.' PMID 40464376 establishes SLC7A11 upregulation as causal in trastuzumab resistance, not correlative. The FBXL2 (Nat Cancer 2026) → CD44high → xCT/SLC7A11 stability axis connects stemness resistance to ferroptosis resistance — both of which T-DXd may overcome via ferroptosis induction in SLC7A11-high/CD44high tumors.

evidence.finding: T-DXd induces ferroptosis via crVDAC3-HSPB1 mitochondrial axis in HER2-low BC. Published prior art for Axis 1.

SLC7A11 epigenetically upregulated (H3K4me3 + DNA hypomethylation) in trastuzumab-resistant HER2+ BC. SLC7A11 inhibition + trastuzumab → ferroptosis synergy. Establishes SLC7A11-high as a trastuzumab-resistance phenotype in HER2+ BC. Published 2025 in eLife.
FBXL2 inhibition → cancer stemness → T-DXd resistance in HER2-neg BC (Nat Cancer 2026). Parallel stemness axis; CD44high connects to SLC7A11 stability (PMID 26930718).
CD44v directly stabilizes xCT/SLC7A11 in cell membrane. MUC1-C-CD44v-xCT complex protects against ferroptosis in TNBC cells. Bridges FBXL2-stemness axis to SLC7A11-ferroptosis resistance.
NRF2 is the transcription factor for SLC7A11 — establishes PI3K-NRF2-SLC7A11 axis.
SLC7A11 CV=59.4% within HER2-enriched (n=78), Q1=104 vs Q3=276 RSEM. High inter-patient variance supports IHC stratification.

novelty.note: T-DXd exploiting trastuzumab-resistance-acquired SLC7A11 upregulation is entirely novel. No paper has proposed this mechanism. PMID 40464376 anchors the SLC7A11-HER2 connection but does not link to T-DXd ferroptosis.

evidential_quality.note: Two published anchor papers (39243601 for Axis 1, 40464376 for Axis 2 foundation). T-DXd-specific ferroptosis via SLC7A11 arm still requires wet lab. Chain has 3 published steps, 1 inferential jump.

clinical_relevance.note: DESTINY-Breast patient population (trastuzumab-pretreated HER2+) is exactly the population with SLC7A11 upregulation per PMID 40464376. Retrospective IHC from archived DESTINY-Breast tumor banks is immediately actionable.

mechanistic_depth.note: v4 unified model: trastuzumab resistance → epigenetic SLC7A11 up → ferroptosis dependency → T-DXd DXd payload exploits it. Each step has published mechanistic support except the final DXd-ferroptosis step.

actionability.note: Three immediate experiments: (1) SLC7A11 IHC on archived DESTINY-Breast tumor blocks + retrospective correlation with T-DXd response; (2) trastuzumab-resistant HER2+ cell lines treated with DXd + SLC7A11 inhibitor; (3) ferrostatin-1 rescue in trastuzumab-resistant cells.

safety_novelty.note: Safety implication: T-DXd patients with trastuzumab-resistant disease may have heightened ferroptosis-related toxicity risk. Warrants liver/iron monitoring in SLC7A11-high pretreated patients.
